description: Yavanna is a team of six from Bath: one aerospace engineer , two chemical engineers, a mechanical engineer, a computer scientist and a physicist. We took on Dancing with the SARs, using NISAR radar to find railway slopes that are slowly moving. Our project, Kestrl, turns satellite data into an interactive 3D map that shows engineers which slopes to inspect first. We love space data, engineering and building tools people can actually use. Our team is now full.
